biocs.name: Process Hollowing - Parent-Child Mismatch
biocs.description: Detects when a process is created with a parent process image name that does not match the child's actual image.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'VirtualAllocEx'
| filter action_file_path contains 'WriteProcessMemory'
| filter action_file_path contains 'SetThreadContext'
